title: click: Bug report from a user of this library
prompt:
This repo is click (an open-source Python library). Bug report from a user of this library:

> The usage line in `--help` shows doubled brackets for optional arguments that use `click.Choice`. With
>
> ```python
> @click.command()
> @click.argument("method", type=click.Choice(["foo", "bar", "baz"]), required=False)
> def cli(method): ...
> ```
>
> `--help` prints `Usage: cli [OPTIONS] [[foo|bar|baz]]`. The same happens with `nargs=-1`, and with other types whose metavar is already in brackets. Expected: `[foo|bar|baz]`.

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
